body:
I have a friend that thought he could combine GBL with baking soda to make GHB. So he had taken GBL and tried drinking baking soda wondering what would happen.
The effects of the GBL were completely nutralized.  He tried to increase dose from 3 ml to 6 to 12 to 15 to 18 then finally 20. All with a three tablespoons of baking soda in water drank. The GBL never effected.  I have seen no known antidote for GHB. How is this possible? He even had a guy drink baking soda water right before he G'ed out and he woke right up and didnt even feel the G. A possible cure for GHB overdose?
